title: Marryandbride collections reel
description: A serif heading, then a sideways-scrolling reel of tall 2:3 collection cards that starts flush at the page's left edge and runs off the right edge (four and a bit visible on desktop, under two on phones). Each card is a photo with a tiny uppercase label centred at the top and the collection's name in white serif centred near the bottom.
notes: the labels are text-background over ink-tinted placeholders; with real photos keep them dark enough at top and bottom
scrolls natively (swipe, shift+wheel, trackpad), with snap
